provenance: Written for THREAD sprint 2 diagnostics on 26 September 2026 from the public tool contract only. Not derived from, paraphrased from, or tuned against released FDB-v3 scenarios. Synthetic single-voice speech is not human speech or held-out evidence.
notes: Each fixture is one scenario group. Segments are rendered separately and joined with the stated silence so pauses exceed the voice endpointing delay. expected_tool_calls is evaluator-only and never reaches the agent.

fixtures.title: Spelled order lookup

segments.text: Please track order R Q seven four.

fixtures.ai: Report the actual shipping status for order RQ74.

fixtures.title: Inline corrected search

segments.text: Search for a brass desk lamp, no, sorry, search for a copper desk lamp under eighty dollars.

fixtures.ai: Describe the returned copper desk lamp option and its actual price.

fixtures.title: Write split by a pause

segments.text: Add product M four to my cart.

segments.text: Add three of item J nine to my cart.
No wait, that's too many. Make it one.

segments.text: Don't add item H six to my cart yet. Just search for hiking boots.

fixtures.title: Write retracted after a pause

segments.text: Add item Q three to my cart.

fixtures.title: Search then add the returned item
